title: Doctor
description: Reports on icon health: list catalog sets (--list), print set metadata (--prefix), and validate icon references (--icon, repeatable). Flags combine into one consolidated report.

project.description: Target project name (required in multiproject workspaces)
project.x-prompt: Which project should the catalog be read for?

icon.description: Icon to validate in prefix:name format. Repeatable: --icon mdi:home --icon mdi:user (Angular CLI) or comma-separated: --icon mdi:home,mdi:user (Nx)
icon.x-prompt: Which icon should be validated? (prefix:name, e.g. mdi:home)

list.description: List icon sets from the catalog (also the default when neither --icon nor --prefix is given)

search.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against set prefix and name

category.description: Only sets whose category matches exactly

limit.description: Cap the number of sets printed (positive integer)

prefix.x-prompt: Which set prefix should be validated? (e.g. mdi)
